cover: UN warns sieges risk new atrocities
Five killed in strikes after Israeli vote
Voter roll nearly one crore smaller

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: UN warns of new atrocities
bullets: A year after the RSF seized El Fasher, UN officials warned on Wednesday that sieges in Kordofan and Blue Nile could bring new atrocities.
UN investigators say they found hallmarks of genocide in El Fasher.
No army or RSF response was reported; the RSF says El Fasher is safe for civilians.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Strikes kill five after Israeli vote
bullets: Gaza's civil defence agency and a hospital say Israeli strikes killed five people on Wednesday.
Three died in a drone strike in Rafah.
The Israeli army said it 'struck terrorists in the area'.

stories.label: India · Due process · Assembly
stories.head: Arrests under anti-terror law
bullets: Police say 69 people were arrested and four detained under Arunachal's Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act over the 23 October arson.
55 cases are registered across three Siang districts.
A minister met 72 villages' representatives and said local communities' rights must stay central.

stories.label: India · Vote
stories.head: Voter roll shrinks after revision
bullets: The final roll, published 27 October, lists about 4.55 crore electors, nearly one crore fewer than before.
Bengaluru's electorate fell from about 1.03 crore to 59.08 lakh.
The Chief Electoral Officer says deletion forms covered electors found ineligible at hearings.
